plan.notes: Source: 'Program: Computer Science Major, BS in Computer Science - University of Tennessee, Knoxville', 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog [ARCHIVED CATALOG], official uTrack term-by-term sequence (Term 1 through Term 8, 'Requirements for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science'), https://catalog.utk.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=43&poid=25484. Transcribed manually from the official catalog term table on 2026-09-30; term credit subtotals verified against the catalog (Term 2: 15; Term 3: 16-17; Term 6: 16; Term 7: 14; Term 8: 15; TOTAL 121-123). Degree confirmed as BS ('Bachelor of Science in Computer Science'). total_credits is set to 121, the catalog minimum: choice slots use their minimum-credit option (e.g. MATH 132 at 3 cr, natural-science minimum 3 cr); see choice_note fields for the full option lists. Choice slots (EF physics sequence, math sequence, Volunteer Core electives, upper-division CS electives, Engaged Inquiries/unrestricted electives, natural science) represent student-choice selections per the catalog footnotes: footnote 1 = COSC 101 proficiency/AP CS A (score 3+) credit; footnote 2 = chosen from the Volunteer Core list, with a minimum of 9 Engaged Inquiries credit hours in at least two subject areas; footnote 3 = approved CS upper-division elective tracks table. The official term table lists uTrack MILESTONE notes (e.g. 'MATH 130 or higher'), which are placement/assessment milestones, not course prerequisites; prereq arrays are therefore left empty rather than inferred. CAVEAT: this is the 2023-2024 archived catalog. The catalog.utk.edu program page for the current 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog could not be retrieved through the available page-fetch tools on 2026-09-30, and the Tickle College of Engineering's 'Computer Science Catalog 2025' advising chart (tickle.utk.edu) shows a revised sequence (e.g. COSC 230 moved to spring of year 1, statistics options for the probability slot), so this plan should be re-verified against the current catalog before student-facing use.

courses.choice_note: Footnote 1: students with significant programming experience may proficiency-exam out of COSC 101; AP Computer Science A score of 3 or better earns COSC 101 credit.

courses.choice_note: Select one: MATH 132 Calculus 1B Infused with Precalculus (3), MATH 141 Calculus I (4), or MATH 147 Honors: Calculus I (4). Minimum credits (3) used in totals.

courses.title: Natural Science Elective
courses.choice_note: Select one: BIOL 101 Introduction to Biology: Cells, Genetics, and Physiology (4), BIOL 150 Organismal and Ecological Biology (3), BIOL 158 Honors: Organismal and Ecological Biology (3), PHYS 231 Fundamentals of Physics: Electricity and Magnetism (3), CHEM 128 Honors: General Chemistry I (4), or one pair: CHEM 102 Principles of Chemistry (3) + CHEM 103 Principles of Chemistry Laboratory (1), or CHEM 122 General Chemistry I (3) + CHEM 123 General Chemistry I Laboratory (1). courses.title: Computer Science Upper-Division Electives (3 courses)
courses.choice_note: Three 3-credit courses. Student choice: approved Computer Science upper-division electives (catalog footnote 3). The department groups acceptable electives into seven tracks (Theory, Systems, Software, Hardware, Scientific Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Cybersecurity); students may mix and match. COSC 493 and COSC 494 may count; up to three COSC 5XX or ECE 5XX courses may count; COSC 422 does not count.
